2020.why: It drew about 3 times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about automatic emergency braking.
2020.pln: about 3 times the average car's complaints
td: Auto braking
Watch for sudden braking or collision warnings with nothing ahead.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Lane assist
Watch for false lane alerts or the wheel tugging on its own.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
